name: Rek'Sai
title: the Void Burrower

Q.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
Q.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within 3 seconds gain 35% Attack Speed and deal an additional 0.3/0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5×AD physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability.
Q.summary: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.

W.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
W.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains 5/10/15/20/25 Move Speed, 65% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.
W.summary: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

E.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
E.description: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing @spell.RekSaiE:BaseDamageCalculation@ physical damage. At max Fury, the bite deals @spell.RekSaiE:EmpoweredDamageCalculation@ true damage instead.
E.summary: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

R.name: Void Rush
R.description: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last 5 seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing 150/250/350 + 1×bonus AD plus 15/20/25% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of Burrow / Un-burrow.
R.summary: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

Passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
Passive.description: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.
Passive.summary: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Burrowing jungler who tracks enemies through tremors and dashes through the ground. Wins ganks with the unburrow knock-up and finishes targets with the R untargetable dash.
strengths: Burrowed movement and tunnels give fast clears and ganks
R makes her untargetable while dashing to the target
weaknesses: Fury-based; weak when out of Fury
Knock-up only from unburrow; easy to dodge
profile.curveNote: Wants Q, W and E for clear and ganks.

Q.notes: Next attacks empowered; burrowed version is a ranged shot.

profile.windowAgainst: Out of Fury or W on cooldown.
